assets.initial_prompt:
Create ONE NEW transparent 3D chibi HUMAN FAMILY illustration for a website card. Use ONLY the Humans card (fourth family card, lower row) in the full reference image as the COMPOSITION AND MATERIAL guide. Do not use the hero people. This is NOT a screenshot crop: newly render original faces/hair details, never reuse reference pixels or recreate an identifiable complete anime character.

Match that card's staggered UPPER-BODY composition faithfully:
- LEFT BACK: a smaller black-haired boy in a dark charcoal hoodie, seen from chest upward, head turned inward. His head is about 80% the central girl's head size. His torso/shoulder is partly hidden behind her. He is a supporting back-layer figure, not a full-body standing doll.
- CENTER FRONT: the main warm-brown-haired girl with a loose high bun and sunny yellow hoodie. Larger face, playful wink, one small natural hand making a peace sign beside cheek. Her head is lower and forward relative to the side figures, hoodie upper torso visible. She glances toward the viewer/friends.
- RIGHT BACK: blond boy with thin dark round glasses, light-gray jacket over white shirt, head slightly higher than both friends, about 85% of girl's head size. His shoulder leans toward her and his eye line turns inward. Back-layer upper torso only.

Three heads are visibly different sizes and heights. Shoulder contact and restrained overlap connect them. Do not make all three equally giant-headed. No full legs, trousers, feet, shoes, seated pose, platform or paper star. This is an upper-body card vignette, NOT three full-body dolls in a row. End the visible clothing below chest/waist in a delicate transparent alpha dissolve over the lowest 5% so it can blend into the card, not a hard rectangular cutoff. Faces, hair, bun and gesture remain fully crisp and intact.

Use the REFERENCE'S pleasing refined 3D collectible rendering, soft skin, airy fine directional hair locks, finely woven clothing, soft luminous studio light, yellow/charcoal/light-gray palette. Avoid hyperreal oversized shiny eyes or overly dense sculptural hair; keep the reference card's cute natural balance.

WIDE LANDSCAPE PNG, about1536x1024. The actual subject silhouette should fit a 215px-wide by150px-high display footprint (ratio about1.43:1), fill about94% canvas width and90–94% height. Only about3% transparent safety border, not a big square canvas with empty space. Do not crop outer hair/hand outlines. Exactly THREE original humans.

Genuine RGBA alpha transparency outside characters and under the gentle bottom dissolve. NO card rectangle, colored background, fog, white backdrop, floor, ground shadow, border, text, caption, UI, logo or watermark.

generation_attempts.prompt:
Generate ONE new transparent 3D animal-family card illustration, using ONLY the ANIMALS CARD (far-right family card in lower row) of the full reference as the exact composition, scale hierarchy, material and color guide. Not the hero. This is a NEW original render, never a pixel crop or copy of a recognizable complete cartoon/anime identity.

Exactly FIVE animals arranged like that card:
FOREGROUND LEFT: the visually largest and nearest, a round orange-and-cream original Shiba. Big round head, short compact body, one playful WINK and open happy mouth with naturally curved small pink tongue. White muzzle/cheeks, pointed complete ears. Turn slightly inward toward friends. Its head is the main anchor, clearly larger than husky's face, not a tiny member.
BACK CENTER: a taller BLACK-and-white husky, happy open-mouth expression, upright complete pointed ears, white muzzle and distinct dark mask. Behind Shiba/pig, slightly smaller head (about85% of Shiba's head), taller overall placement, body partly occluded. Lean naturally beside Shiba, not a vertical giant floating head.
FOREGROUND RIGHT: a substantial pink pig with a round plump body, flat two-nostril snout, small floppy ears and short little hooves. Head/body scale about90% of Shiba's visual mass. Tilt gently inward toward the Shiba.
BACK RIGHT: a considerably SMALLER brown monkey, round ears, peach muzzle, short limbs and curved attached tail; about60% of Shiba's head size. Peek from behind pig and touch pig's upper back with one animal paw. It is a supporting back-layer character, not as large as foreground dog/pig.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT: a TINY white bird with blue wings, small yellow crest and yellow-orange beak, about30% of Shiba head size. Perch in the gap above husky/monkey as the highest little accent. Tiny feet touch a friend's back, not detached floating. Keep bird distinctly small.

Match the reference's broad low stepped composition, around215px wide and150px tall when displayed: large Shiba FRONT-LEFT, happy husky taller BACK-MIDDLE, pig FRONT-RIGHT, monkey SMALLER BACK-RIGHT, bird TINY TOP. Scale hierarchy must be obvious. Not equal heads, not a tall stacked pyramid, not five upright symmetrical toy soldiers. Overlapping sides, natural adjacent contact, slightly varied head angles and shared inward eye lines. Shiba is main focal subject, pig second. No white cat or penguin, no sixth animal.

Use the reference card's refined dense short-plush/soft 3D texture, delicate directional fur, soft luminous studio lighting, bright warm orange/cream, deep black-white, soft pink and warm brown. Compact short bodies. No overly long limbs, overly shiny eyes or hyperreal portrait fur. Original animal proportions/features.

WIDE LANDSCAPE RGBA PNG around1536x1024, subject silhouette about1.43–1.5:1, fills most canvas with about3% tight transparent border. Entire head/ear/bird/monkey-tail outlines intact. Lower paws may naturally partly overlap neighbors; do not stretch composition to reveal every hidden foot. No giant square empty margins.
Absolutely no card background, floor, separate ground shadow, backdrop, colored glow, border, UI, title, text, logo or watermark. Genuine transparency alpha0 outside animals.
